title: Breast Cancer Prognosis via Gaussian Mixture Regression
title_en: Breast Cancer Prognosis via Gaussian Mixture Regression
title_zh: 通过高斯混合回归进行乳腺癌预后
abstract_en: This paper compares the performance of classification and regression trees (CART), multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), and a Gaussian mixture regressor (GMR) method in predicting breast cancer recurrence time in patients that have undergone cancer excision. It is shown that the GMR-based algorithm demonstrates an improved performance compared to CART and MARS. Moreover, GMR performance is comparable to that of a baseline predictor with the advantage of performing automatic feature selection and model optimization
abstract_zh: 本文比较了分类和回归树 (CART)、多元自适应回归样条 (MARS) 和高斯混合回归 (GMR) 方法在预测接受癌症切除的患者的乳腺癌复发时间方面的性能。结果表明，与 CART 和 MARS 相比，基于 GMR 的算法表现出更好的性能。此外，GMR 性能与基线预测器相当，具有执行自动特征选择和模型优化的优势

title: An improved GMM-based voice quality predictor
title_en: An improved GMM-based voice quality predictor
title_zh: 改进的基于 GMM 的语音质量预测器
abstract_en: A voice quality prediction method based on Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) is improved by constructing a feature selection algorithm to provide the best GMM-based prediction quality. The proposed sequential se-lection algorithm performs N-survivor search, allowing for trading between design complexity and performance. Simulation shows that predictors designed using the pro-posed algorithm outperform two benchmark selection al-gorithms. Performance improvements over the ITU-T P.862 PESQ standard are also attained. 1.
abstract_zh: 通过构建特征选择算法改进基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的语音质量预测方法，以提供最佳的基于GMM的预测质量。所提出的顺序选择算法执行 N 幸存者搜索，允许在设计复杂性和性能之间进行权衡。仿真表明，使用所提出的算法设计的预测器优于两种基准选择算法。与 ITU-T P.862 PESQ 标准相比，性能也得到了改进。 1.

title: Non-Intrusive GMM-Based Speech Quality Measurement
title_en: Non-Intrusive GMM-Based Speech Quality Measurement
title_zh: 基于 GMM 的非侵入式语音质量测量
abstract_en: We propose a non-intrusive speech quality measurement algorithm based on using Gaussian-mixture probability models of features of undegraded speech signals as an artificial reference model of "clean" speech behaviour. The consistency between the features of the test speech signal and the reference model serves as an indicator of speech quality. Consistency measures are calculated and mapped to an objective speech quality score using a multivariate adaptive regression splines function. Simulation results show that the proposed method offers accurate and yet low-complexity measurement of speech quality.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种非侵入式语音质量测量算法，该算法基于使用未降级语音信号特征的高斯混合概率模型作为“干净”语音行为的人工参考模型。测试语音信号特征与参考模型特征的一致性作为语音质量的指标。使用多元自适应回归样条函数计算一致性度量并将其映射到客观语音质量分数。仿真结果表明，所提出的方法提供了准确且复杂度低的语音质量测量。

title: Feature mining for GMM-based speech quality measurement
title_en: Feature mining for GMM-based speech quality measurement
title_zh: 基于 GMM 的语音质量测量的特征挖掘
venue: Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems and Computers (ACSSC)
abstract_en: We propose a novel approach to objective speech quality measurement using feature mining and Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). A large pool of perceptual distortion features is extracted from the speech signal and data mining techniques are used to sift out the most relevant feature variables from the pool. We examine using multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), classification and regression trees (CART), a hybrid CART-MARS scheme, and the sequential forward selection (SFS) algorithm for data mining. For our speech databases, the SFS algorithm provides best performance with a five-feature, three-component GMM. A reduction of 21.7% in root-mean-squared mean opinion score estimation error is obtained in comparison with ITU-T P.862 PESQ.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种使用特征挖掘和高斯混合模型（GMM）进行客观语音质量测量的新方法。从语音信号中提取大量感知失真特征，并使用数据挖掘技术从池中筛选出最相关的特征变量。我们研究使用多元自适应回归样条 (MARS)、分类和回归树 (CART)、混合 CART-MARS 方案以及顺序前向选择 (SFS) 算法进行数据挖掘。对于我们的语音数据库，SFS 算法通过五特征、三分量 GMM 提供最佳性能。与ITU-T P.862 PESQ相比，均方根平均意见得分估计误差降低了21.7%。

title: A sequential feature selection algorithm for GMM-based speech quality estimation
title_en: A sequential feature selection algorithm for GMM-based speech quality estimation
title_zh: 基于 GMM 的语音质量估计的顺序特征选择算法
abstract_en: We propose a sequential feature selection algorithm for de-signing Gaussian mixture model (GMM) based estimators. Feature selection is performed progressively to minimize es-timation errors. The algorithm is applied to design estima-tors of subjective speech quality. Simulation shows that es-timators designed using the proposed algorithm outperform two benchmark algorithms by as much as 39 % in correlation and 24 % in root-mean-squared error. Furthermore, features selected by the proposed algorithm are suitable for diago-nal GMM estimators, which incur lower computational com-plexity. 1.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种顺序特征选择算法，用于设计基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的估计器。逐步执行特征选择以最小化估计误差。该算法用于设计主观语音质量估计器。仿真表明，使用所提出的算法设计的估计器在相关性方面优于两种基准算法高达 39％，在均方根误差方面优于两种基准算法高达 24％。此外，所提出的算法选择的特征适用于对角 GMM 估计器，其计算复杂度较低。 1.

title: Multiple-channel optimized quantizers for Rayleigh fading channels
title_en: Multiple-channel optimized quantizers for Rayleigh fading channels
title_zh: 针对瑞利衰落通道的多通道优化量化器
venue: Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems and Computers (ACSSC)
abstract_en: We consider multiple description communication over Rayleigh fading channels with binary phase-shift keying (BPSK) modulators at the transmitter and soft-decision detectors at the receiver. The multiple-channel optimized quantizer design (MCOQD) method, introduced in Y. Zhou et al., (2004) for multiple discrete memoryless channels, is extended to multiple Rayleigh fading channels. The decision thresholds of the soft-decision detectors are optimized to achieve minimum end-to-end distortion. Simulation results show that MCOQD provides more robust quantizers than multiple description scalar quantizers V. Vaishampayan (1993) over Rayleigh fading channels, when both the encoder and decoder are matched to channel statistics and when only the decoder is matched to channel statistics.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑在发射器处使用二进制相移键控（BPSK）调制器和在接收器处使用软判决检测器的瑞利衰落信道上的多描述通信。 Y. Zhou 等人 (2004) 中针对多个离散无记忆通道引入的多通道优化量化器设计 (MCOQD) 方法已扩展到多个瑞利衰落通道。软决策检测器的决策阈值经过优化，以实现最小的端到端失真。仿真结果表明，当编码器和解码器都与信道统计数据匹配并且仅解码时，MCOQD 在瑞利衰落信道上提供比多描述标量量化器 V. Vaishampayan (1993) 更鲁棒的量化器。

title: Speech quality estimation using Gaussian mixture models
title_en: Speech quality estimation using Gaussian mixture models
title_zh: 使用高斯混合模型进行语音质量估计
abstract_en: —An algorithm for nonintrusive speech quality esti-mation based on Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) is presented. GMMs are used to form an artificial reference model of the behavior of features of undegraded speech. Consistency measures between the degraded speech signal and the reference model serve as indicators of speech quality. Consistency values are mapped to an objective speech quality score using a multivariate adaptive regression splines function. When tested on unseen data, the proposed algorithm generally outperforms ITU-T standard P.563, which is the current “state-of-the-art ” algorithm. The algorithm computes objective quality scores roughly twice as fast as P.563. Index Terms—Gaussian mixtures, quality assurance, quality measurement, quality of service, speech coding, speech quality, speech transmission, telephony. I.
abstract_zh: —提出了一种基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的非侵入式语音质量估计算法。 GMM 用于形成未降级语音特征行为的人工参考模型。降级语音信号与参考模型之间的一致性度量用作语音质量的指标。使用多元自适应回归样条函数将一致性值映射到客观语音质量分数。当对未见过的数据进行测试时，所提出的算法通常优于 ITU-T 标准 P.563，这是当前“最先进”的算法。该算法计算客观质量分数的速度大约是 P.563 的两倍。索引术语—高斯混合、质量保证、质量测量...

title: Finite-state Markov modeling of correlated Rician-fading channels
title_en: Finite-state Markov modeling of correlated Rician-fading channels
title_zh: 相关莱斯衰落信道的有限状态马尔可夫模型
abstract_en: Stochastic properties of the binary channel that describe the successes and failures of the transmission of a modulated signal over a time-correlated flat-fading channel are considered for investigation. This analysis is employed to develop Kth-order Markov models for such a burst channel. The order of the Markov model that generates accurate analytical models is estimated for a broad range of fading environments. The parameterization and accuracy of an important class of hidden Markov models, known as the Gilbert-Elliott channel (GEC), are also investigated. Fading rates are identified in which the Kth-order Markov model and the GEC model approximate the fading channel with similar accuracy. The latter model is useful for approximating slowly fading processes, since it provides a more compact parameterization.
abstract_zh: 描述在时间相关的平坦衰落信道上传输调制信号的成功和失败的二进制信道的随机属性被考虑进行研究。该分析用于开发此类突发通道的 K 阶马尔可夫模型。针对广泛的衰落环境，估计了生成准确分析模型的马尔可夫模型的阶数。还研究了一类重要的隐马尔可夫模型（称为吉尔伯特-埃利奥特通道（GEC））的参数化和准确性。确定衰落率，其中 K 阶马尔可夫模型和 GEC 模型以相似的精度近似衰落信道。后一个模型对于近似慢速很有用...

title: Decomposição de Wavelets sobre Corpos Finitos
title_en: Decomposição de Wavelets sobre Corpos Finitos
title_zh: 小波有限元分解
venue: Journal of Communication and Information Systems
abstract_en: This paper introduces some foundations of wavelets over Galois fields. Standard orthogonal finite-field wavelets (FF-Wavelets) including FF-Haar and FF-Daubechies are derived. Non-orthogonal FF-wavelets such as B-splines over GF(p) are also considered. A few examples of multiresolution analysis over finite fields as well as conditions for the coefficients of the smoothing filter to achieve vanishing moments are presented. A new fast algorithm to compute FF-wavelets, based on a two-phase decomposition is introduced. Wavelet packed transforms over finite fields are also considered. An application of FF-wavelets to design multiplex schemes with spread-spectrum sequences is presented.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了伽罗瓦域上小波的一些基础。推导了包括FF-Haar 和FF-Daubechies 在内的标准正交有限场小波(FF-Wavelet)。还考虑非正交 FF 小波，例如 GF(p) 上的 B 样条。给出了有限域上多分辨率分析的几个例子以及平滑滤波器系数实现消失矩的条件。介绍了一种基于两阶段分解的计算 FF 小波的新快速算法。还考虑了有限域上的小波打包变换。提出了 FF 小波在设计扩频序列复用方案中的应用。

title: Impulse sensitivity functions of oscillators
title_en: Impulse sensitivity functions of oscillators
title_zh: 振荡器的脉冲灵敏度函数
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems proceedings
abstract_en: We define two impulse sensitivity functions (ISF) describing the transient and the stationary effects of perturbations on the trajectory of oscillators. These functions give an insight into the sensitivity of the oscillator over time. They can be used to rate different oscillators according to their sensitivity to perturbations, e.g. by noise. Both functions are derived from the properties of the corresponding dynamic system model and its monodromy matrix. The calculation of the ISF is shown and correlations between the nonlinearity contained in the oscillator and its noise behaviour is demonstrated by an example.
abstract_zh: 我们定义了两个脉冲灵敏度函数（ISF）来描述扰动对振荡器轨迹的瞬态和稳态影响。这些函数可以让您深入了解振荡器随时间变化的灵敏度。它们可用于根据不同的振荡器对扰动的敏感度来对其进行评级，例如通过噪音。这两个函数都是从相应的动态系统模型及其单性矩阵的性质导出的。显示了 ISF 的计算，并通过示例演示了振荡器中包含的非线性与其噪声行为之间的相关性。

title: The middle ear bioelectronic microphone for a totally implantable cochlear hearing device for profound and total hearing loss
title_en: The middle ear bioelectronic microphone for a totally implantable cochlear hearing device for profound and total hearing loss
title_zh: 用于完全植入式耳蜗听力装置的中耳生物电子麦克风，可治疗严重和完全听力损失
abstract_en: BACKGROUND: A bioelectronic middle ear microphone (BMEM) has been developed in a laboratory bench model and successfully tested in fresh human temporal bones. A transducer actually has been bench-tested in our laboratory; it was implanted in chronic animal experiments (cats) as well as in humans for a period of 1 year as a driver of a semi-implantable electromagnetic middle ear hearing device (IDE, FDA approved). This BMEM is the result of the use of this same electromagnetic transducer used in a reverse mode. The applicability of the BMEM is for the development of a totally implantable cochlear implant using the eardrum as a diaphragm that transmits vibrations to a magnet cemented to the ossicles. This BMEM is to be powered by a lithium-ion implantable, rechargeable battery. MATERIALS AND METHODS: To test the efficacy of this BMEM, the experiment was divided into two parts: (1) bench model, and (2) fresh human temporal bones, using an air-core electromagnetic (EM) coil and a ferrite core EM coil for comparison. RESULTS: In the bench model, the average displacement at 3 kHz was 0.95 microns (peak) for 4 V p-p and 1.65 microns (peak) for 10 V p-p. At 5 kHz, the measurements were somewhat higher. In fresh human temporal bones, with sound source in the ear canal (60 dB HL and 90 dB HL), the result was better with the magnet implanted on the head of the malleus with the incus removed. The ferrite core EM coil with the magnet implanted on the malleus with the incus removed was compared with the air-core EM coil. At 60 dB HL, the ferrite core EM coil yielded more than four times the amplitude of the EM coil. At 90 dB HL, the ferrite core EM coil produced more than five times the amplitude compared with the air-core coil. CONCLUSION: This BMEM using an EM ferrite coil and a permanent magnet on the head of the malleus is more efficient when compared with an EM air-core coil. This BMEM may be applicable to the construction of a totally implantable cochlear implant. Further research is necessary to integrate this BMEM with the other components of the design concept of the totally implantable cochlear implant.
